facts.summary: Phase 2 trial showed no difference from placebo on primary endpoint · Phase 2 · zetomipzomib in dermatomyositis/polymyositis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Topline results of the PRESIDIO trial showed that most DM and PM patients saw clinically meaningful improvements in TIS, but zetomipzomib demonstrated no significant differentiation from placebo.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: At Week 16, the zetomipzomib 45 mg SC weekly group achieved a mean TIS of 25.5 versus the control group mean TIS of 25.
evidence.safety: Zetomipzomib was well tolerated over the course of the PRESIDIO trial.
